sloka: हेम जालैर् अविच्चिन्नाः तरुण आदित्य सम्निभाः ।ददर्श राक्षस इन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने ॥५-६-३५॥
transliteration: hema jālair aviccinnāḥ taruṇa āditya samnibhāḥ ।dadarśa rākṣasa indrasya rāvaṇasya niveśane ॥5-6-35॥

translations.english: He saw in the palace of Ravana, the demon king, thousands of troops adorned with gold, fully protected with armour of gold shining like the morning Sun.
